text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — customer legal scheduled an incident simulation playback for next Tue 09:00 PT. They want a replay of an incident where an ephemeral keystore rotated and a few service tokens were revoked. They specifically asked for: RBAC change history, KMS key activity, audit log bundle, and a short narrative we can sign off on. Who can own artifacts?

Sanjay Patel: I can own RBAC change history + who did the role grant. I need the exact audit query syntax.

Elaine Ortiz: I can grab KMS activity (rotation events + grant changes). Where do we pull rotation proof from? Is it HSM audit or cloud KMS?

Tom Nguyen: For this customer it's a hybrid pilot — KMS is cloud-hosted but we had an on-prem HSM proxy for that tenant. So we'll need both: cloud key rotation logs and HSM attestation snippet.

Rebecca Holt: I'll prepare the narrative + timeline. Quick ask: do we have a redaction policy for user IDs before sending to the customer?

Mia Chen: Yes — scrub PII and only include internal IDs. Security-approved template is in the evidence playbook. Link: https://go/internal/evidence-playbook (internal).

Sanjay Patel: Ops-oncall, can you run the RBAC change query and export to csv? Need role mappings + before/after snapshots for the last 7 days.

ops-oncall-bot: Scheduled query queued: rbacs.export --scope tenant:acme --range "2026-03-10..2026-03-17" --format csv. ETA ~2m.

Tom Nguyen: While that's running — note we had a mitigation step where we temporarily elevated a service account to apply a migration. Need to flag that as planned maintenance in the narrative.

Elaine Ortiz: I pulled preliminary KMS events. Sample event: `{"time":"2026-03-12T02:34:10Z","event":"key_rotation","key_id":"arn:redwood:kms:us-west-2:acct:key/abcd1234","actor":"svc-migration"}`. Will include HSM attestation PDF separately.

Sanjay Patel: RBAC export done. Attached snippet below (sanitized):
```
actor,action,target,ts,prev_role,new_role
svc-migration,grant,svc-data-writer,1710002345,none,service:writer
alice.ops,grant,user-bob,1710009300,viewer,editor
```

Mia Chen: Good. Rebecca, please add a one-paragraph explanation for the svc-migration grant — include approval path and expiration. Keep it under 5 sentences.

Rebecca Holt: Drafted paragraph: "On 2026-03-12, svc-migration was temporarily granted service:writer to perform a planned migration. Approval recorded in IAM tickets #INC-4432 and #PM-118. Grant was scoped to tenant:acme and auto-revoked after 90m via our ephemeral-grant workflow. No data exfiltration indicators were observed during the window." Thoughts?

Tom Nguyen: Please add the remediation step about rotating all tokens that svc-migration used. We rotated the rotation key and also invalidated any long-lived tokens issued before 2026-03-12T03:30Z.

Elaine Ortiz: HSM attestation file uploaded to internal bucket at: gs://redwood-sec-evidence/acme/attestations/2026-03-12-hsm.pdf (access: security/evidence-read). Include checksum: sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (truncated).

Sanjay Patel: One open question from the customer: they want to see proof that RBAC changes require two-step approval for production-scoped grants. Our logs show a single approver for svc-migration. Is that an exception or audit gap?

Mia Chen: That was an exception under our emergency maintenance policy — it should be documented as an exception with ticket reference. We must include the exception approval doc.

Rebecca Holt: Attached exception doc: https://go/internal/exception-approvals/INC-4432.pdf. It includes the second-level approval email thread redacted.

Tom Nguyen: Security/Vuln triage note — during the window vuln scanner flagged an outdated lib on one of the migration containers. That triggered a temporary patch and redeploy. We should include the vuln ticket and patch timeline too.

Elaine Ortiz: Added vuln ticket ID VULN-2026-1387 and remediation timestamp to the timeline.

ops-oncall-bot: Evidence bundle prepared (partial): rbacs.csv, kms-events.json, hsm-attest.pdf (redacted), narrative-draft.md. Bundle size: 12.3MB. Upload link: https://files.internal/redwood-evidence/3167890123/bundle.zip

Sanjay Patel: Before we hand off, customer asked for audit log chainproof showing logs were not tampered. We currently support append-only log attestations via our logsign service. Do we have a signed proof for that date range?

Mia Chen: Yes — logsign generated a signed manifest. Attached: logsign-manifest.sig (also in the bundle). Explain the verification steps in the narrative (openssl verify + public key).

Rebecca Holt: Narrative updated with verification steps and redaction summary. Added checklist for legal: items included, items redacted and reasons.

Tom Nguyen: Quick technical appendix for them: commands we used to extract KMS events: 
```
redwoodctl kms audit export --tenant acme --from 2026-03-12T00:00Z --to 2026-03-12T06:00Z --out kms-events.json
redwoodctl logs query --scope tenant:acme --q "rbac_changes" --out rbacs.csv
```

Sanjay Patel: I recommend we also include a small assertion: MD5 (rbacs.csv) and SHA256 (bundle.zip) so customer can verify integrity.

Mia Chen: Agreed. Rebecca, finalize and push to the secure share. I'll run a quick pre-call review Thu morning.

Rebecca Holt: Finalized. Uploaded sanitized bundle to secure share: https://secure-share.internal/acme/incident-playback-3167890123. Sent access to customer legal with one-time view.

ops-oncall-bot: Reminder: pre-call review scheduled Thu 08:30 PT.

Sanjay Patel: Thanks all. Post-call action: schedule follow-up to close exception and add 2nd approver required for any prod-scoped ephemeral grants.

Mia Chen: Adding to roadmap. Closing out here — good job everyone. :thumbsup:
